comment: What this version of cloud-env supports, for a reader such as Navark's setup wizard. Kept in step with defaults.sh, detect.py and the README's table; tests/test_manifest.py checks it.

stacks.label: Laravel
stacks.detectedBy: an artisan file at the root of the repository

php.detectedFrom: require.php of composer.json, raised by composer.lock

languages.image: Python 3 with pip, uv and poetry; Node 20, 21 and 22; Ruby 3.1 to 3.3 with bundler; Go; Rust; Java 21
languages.otherVersions: mise, from a mise.toml, .mise.toml or .tool-versions in the repository

mysql.label: MySQL
mysql.detectedFrom: DB_CONNECTION of .env.example, then the first mysql:x.y image in .github/workflows

pgsql.label: PostgreSQL
pgsql.detectedFrom: DB_CONNECTION of .env.example, then the first postgres:NN image in .github/workflows

ownEnvironment.keep: Clone this repository at a version and run setup.sh at the end of your own setup script, or the session has no guard and no hooks for the Navark flow.

references.name: mise
references.for: Any language version the image does not ship (Python, Ruby, Node, Go, Java, ...). cloud-env installs it when the repository has a mise.toml or .tool-versions.

references.name: Dev Container Features
references.for: Install scripts per tool (languages, CLIs, databases), maintained by the Dev Containers community: a source to copy into a setup script. Not run by cloud-env.

references.name: Railpack
references.for: How a project of a given language is detected, installed and started, from Railway's builder. A reference for writing a custom .claude/cloud.sh. Not run by cloud-env.
